issue.title: Timezone example in the docs uses a removed argument
issue.body:
The "Working with timezones" page shows:

```python
parse_date("2024-05-01 14:00", timezone="UTC")
```

But the `timezone` argument was renamed to `tz` in v2.0, so copying the example fails with `TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'timezone'`. The code works fine with `tz=` — it's only the documentation page that's out of date.
